(own `m4` DAG);'''

(own `m4` DAG; 2 flips);'''

assert s.count(old)==1; s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''Files (stdlib + numpy only):'''
new='''Blindness: nothing under `experiments/EXP-SEMBIN-cb5e25/code/` or `review/` (other than this directory) was opened, and no
git log/commit message was read (only `git status --short` and `git diff -- formats.md`, to see what the producer changed in

`CHECKPOINT_SKIP=<reason>` opt-out of the run-launcher hook (AGENTS.md, "Resume checkpoints in S3 before every run": a command
that is not an experiment run may opt out); they are checker unit-test sweeps, not experiment trials.

Files (stdlib + numpy only):'''
assert s.count(old)==1; s=s.replace(old,new)

  joints_owned: []
  sources_read:
    - AGENTS.md (section headings; Review architecture; Resume checkpoints in S3 before every run)

    - blind sample directories m3n05 and m3n06 (systems, wdag certificates, instances.jsonl.gz, closures.jsonl.gz, cost.jsonl, trials/*.json)
    - git status --short and git diff of formats.md only

    - experiments/EXP-SEMBIN-cb5e25/review/ other than checker/
  read_sibling_reports: false
  blind_from_respected: true
  honesty_notes:

    - git status listed modified code/ file names; none was diffed or opened.
    - The checker and its reference test builders share one author: independence is from the producer's code, not between the two.
    - Long bit-flip sweeps ran under the documented CHECKPOINT_SKIP opt-out (checker unit sweeps, not experiment trials).

EOF
